items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: he and Kenneth, who kept, and Marvin, studying out at TCU, who told the people about me and had me go out there.

ctx.x: Well, the music's worse. I mean, a good classical musician maybe or maybe couldn't fit into some of these other forms, but you felt the forms were close enough then.

Now, this Cecil Brower that we're talking about, the one who is the leading hillbilly violinist right now in Nashville, making more records than anybody in the area of hillbilly music is, make no mistake about it, a classical violinist. No doubt about it, and he was the one, he and Kenneth, who kept, and Marvin, studying out at TCU, who told the people about me and had me go out there. The first day I went out there, I was scared to death, and the teacher had me come in and asked me to play the man I love, and I…
